basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 14.' and it opens 'Vers. 14. In monte Dominus videbit. Hoc quasi proverbium obtinuit apud Judaeos ut quoties'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 14. In monte Dominus videbit. Hoc quasi proverbium obtinuit apud Judaeos ut quoties aliqua necessitate vel angustia tenentur, dicant: In monte Dominus videbit, vel ut in Hebraeo habetur: In monte Dominus videbitur, hoc est miserebitur et liberabit nos.
